title: Downbelow Station
author: C. J. Cherryh
summary: As war between Earth's Company and the Union spreads, Pell Station, a trading hub above a planet of native people, becomes a refuge and a flashpoint for stations, merchants and fleets.
readIf: you like dense, politically minded space opera with many factions.
skipIf: you want a light, action-first space adventure with one hero.
